english.meaning: some time after twelve o'clock, minutes not specified
english.note: 點幾 after an hour number means a few minutes past it.

exampleSentences.english: So we didn’t get to the vineyard until after twelve.
exampleSentences.traditional: 所以搞到成，即係成十二點幾先去葡萄園呢。
